hooks.name: overfull-guard
hooks.command: if command -v overfull >/dev/null 2>&1; then overfull guard --hook gemini; elif [ -f overfull.yml ] && grep -qi '\.bib'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"overfull is not on PATH, so the .bib guard did not run. Add references with `make cite ARGS=...` (Docker) or install overfull."}'; fi
